newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Thailand bunker prices rise by $4/T on bad weather.
newsitem.headline: Thailand bunker prices rise by $4/T on bad weather.

text.p: Bunker prices in Thailand firmed on Wednesday after storms hit the east coast of Thailand, industry sources said.
Prices have edged by $4 per tonne to $134, up from Tuesday's $130 per tonne for 180 centistoke (cst) bunker fuel, a bunker trader in Thailand told Reuters.
Prices for 380-cst have also edged higher to $132, the trader said
"The bad weather have made it very difficult for barges to get near the big ships," the trader said.
"We cannot supply at Ko Si Chang and Sri Racha as the seas are rough," said another Thai bunker trader.
Thai bunker traders said they are monitoring the weather everyday. The country's monsoon season last until late November, traders said.
They said volumes have also been reduced but could not provide further details.
